facts.fact: The State Information Technology Agency says municipalities across the Eastern Cape are actively operational on its web-based Provincial Disaster Management Application System, built with the provincial cooperative governance department and supported by SITA's provincial team; it gives no count of municipalities and does not describe their offices' connection.

The Provincial Disaster Management Application System went live on 21 November 2025 with training for provincial and municipal users across the Eastern Cape, replacing manual reporting and telephone-based coordination, according to SITA.

systems.platform: web-based, built in-house by SITA's Eastern Cape team
systems.owner: State Information Technology Agency with the Eastern Cape Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs
systems.tiers: Eastern Cape province and its municipalities

note: The connection is inferred from municipal users working in a shared web-based provincial system; one province only, no count, and no office connection described.
